senses.en_definition: A layer or tier of something arranged one above another; a floor or storey of a building.
A level, rank, or degree of status, achievement, or development.
A stage or point reached in a process or course of events.

messages.en: I'm on the fifth floor now. What's your flat number?
5-08. Just turn right when you get out of the lift. There's a big flowerpot outside the door.
Ah, I see it. I'm outside now. Can you let me in?

senses.en_definition: Deceit; a dishonest act, lie, or trick intended to mislead someone.
To deceive or trick someone; to lie (colloquial).

messages.en: I haven't seen that film yet, but I know who the killer is.
Oh, stop lying 😂 You've already seen it, haven't you? You said yourself yesterday that you wanted to watch it.
Haha, you caught me. I watched it last night. Don't worry, I won't spoil the ending.
There are a few drops of water on this table. Give it a wipe first, okay?
Okay, I've got a cloth. I'll wipe it now.

senses.en_definition: Abbreviation of tuan, a respectful title used before a man's name, equivalent to Mr; normally written Tn.
Short for tuan in text messages, used to address the recipient respectfully as sir.

messages.en: Hello, sir. I'm Amir, the one who submitted a form this morning. Have you received my form?
Hello, yes, we've received it. All the documents are there. We'll let you know once the review is complete.
All right, sir. Thank you. I'll wait to hear from you.
